name: Seychelles
shortSummary: Seychelles is one of India's closest Indian Ocean partners, with deep maritime security cooperation through the Colombo Security Conclave and Indian-funded coastal surveillance infrastructure.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: India has funded coastal radar and surveillance infrastructure supporting Seychelles' Indian Ocean security.

sources.title: Bilateral brief
sources.publisher: Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India
